title: Mountain Lakes Tour with Hiking and Scenic Walks
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore stunning mountain scenery with leisurely walks around serene lakes like Mirror Lake and Ruth Lake to breathtaking overlooks. This tour offers a perfect blend of nature and adventure, allowing you to connect with the great outdoors at your own pace. 

- Experience the beauty of Mirror Lake and other mountain lakes
- Suitable for all fitness levels and adventure seekers
- Perfect for nature lovers looking for a unique outdoor experience
